summary.name: OpenSparta
summary.one_liner: OpenSparta is an AI agent for Telegram that finds relevant conversations, writes contextual comments, and manages Telegram accounts and proxies from one workspace.
use_cases: Finding relevant Telegram conversations to join
Managing multiple Telegram accounts and proxies
Monitoring account health and rate limits
summary.what_it_does: The page describes OpenSparta as an AI agent for Telegram that discovers relevant conversations and automates contextual commenting so the right people can find the user. It also manages Telegram accounts and proxies in one workspace and runs account health checks. It states it uses official Telegram client protocols, per-account safety limits, and FloodWait quarantine to keep accounts stable. The page says paid modules can be opened in preview mode before purchase. Specific features beyond these are not detailed on the page.
notable: Discovers relevant Telegram conversations and writes contextual comments with AI
Manages Telegram accounts and proxies with account health checks
Uses official Telegram client protocols with per-account safety limits and FloodWait quarantine
Paid modules can be previewed before buying
caveats: Paid modules and All Access are optional paid tiers; current prices are on a separate pricing page not included here
AI credits are included with paid plans, amounts not stated on this page
